products.name: ZDM-E5 Dental Lab Milling Machine
products.tagline: The all-in-one starter mill: five-axis dry milling for zirconia, PMMA, wax and PEEK.
products.description: Zahndent presents the ZDM-E5 as an all-in-one starter milling machine for dental laboratories. It mills crowns, copings, bridges and inlays/onlays from 98 mm discs in five axes, using a water-cooled 1.2 kW Haozhi spindle that reaches 60,000 RPM and an automatic six-position tool changer. It is operated from a touch display, and the window door at the front is hinged at its lower edge and folds outward for loading. CAM is HyperDent.
labValue: An entry point into in-house milling: zirconia, PMMA, wax and PEEK without outsourcing.
Automatic tool change across six positions lets long jobs run unattended; Zahndent states each DC-coated bur carves about 600 teeth.
Zahndent states a full-arch cut takes about 1.5 hours, with an average zirconia crown time of 8 to 15 minutes.
Mills from standard 98 mm discs, the common disc format across the industry.

products.name: ZDM-5T Pro Dental Lab Milling Machine
products.tagline: Wet and dry five-axis milling for zirconia, titanium, glass ceramic, PMMA and wax, with a 12-tool changer.
products.description: Zahndent's ZDM-5T, sold as the 5T Pro, is a five-axis dental lab milling machine that works both dry and wet. Besides zirconia, PMMA and wax it mills titanium and lithium disilicate glass ceramic, from 98 mm discs, glass-ceramic blocks and pre-milled titanium rods. Servo motors drive every axis; a water-cooled 2.2 kW spindle runs up to 60,000 RPM and an automatic changer holds 12 tools with 6 mm shanks. It covers crowns and bridges through abutments, partial frameworks, surgical guides, models and full dentures. A touch screen sits above the milling window, and the window door folds open from its lower edge for loading. A water chiller, water tank and jigs for ceramic and titanium come with the machine; CAM is HyperDent.
labValue: One machine for dry zirconia and PMMA work and wet milling of glass ceramic and titanium.
Custom abutments, pre-milled titanium abutments and partial frameworks can be made in-house instead of outsourced.
A 12-tool magazine with automatic change lets long jobs with several materials run unattended.
Zahndent states an average crown time of 8 to 15 minutes in zirconia or PMMA, 5 to 8 minutes in wax and 20 to 25 minutes in titanium.

products.name: AI-S3 High-Speed Desktop Lab Scanner
products.tagline: Blue-light desktop scanner: single arch in 8.5 s, ≤0.006 mm accuracy, true-color texture.
products.description: A high-speed desktop scanner for dental labs, built on blue-light fringe (grating) projection with dual 2.4 MP cameras. It digitises models, dies and impressions, with true-color texture at one click, and exports open STL, PLY and OBJ data for exocad, 3Shape and other CAD software. Aident specifies ≤0.006 mm accuracy (ISO 12836) and a 94 × 89 × 60 mm scan area, and positions it for high-volume batch work.
labValue: Speed for batch orders: 1 s occlusion, 8.5 s single arch, 18 s full impression (Aident brochure).
Direct impression scanning skips the gypsum model; double-sided impressions are aligned automatically.
AI screw-channel closure fills implant scan-body channels automatically, so implant data goes to CAD without manual repair.
Open data (STL/PLY/OBJ) goes straight into exocad or 3Shape without trimming or gap filling.

products.tagline: A 198 g powder-free intraoral scanner with anti-fog heating, made for comfortable chairside scans.
products.description: Aident presents the AIDEN AI-30 as "the most comfortable dental mouth scanner for patients and doctors". The handheld wand weighs 198 g, scans powder-free at 30 frames per second or more and heats its window to stop fogging in the mouth. Aident states an accuracy of 10 μm or better over a 0–25 mm depth of field, in true colour. Standard and mini tips are available, and scans export as STL, PLY or OBJ for any CAD or lab workflow.
labValue: Brings impressions into the digital workflow: clinics send STL/PLY/OBJ scans straight to the lab, ready for design and milling.
At 198 g it is among the lightest wands, which matters on long or full-arch scans.
Powder-free scanning with anti-fog heating and a mini tip for children and patients with limited opening.
Aident lists free lifetime software upgrades, remote installation help and operator training.

products.name: ZDS-08 Dental Sintering Furnace
products.tagline: Fast and normal zirconia sintering up to 1650 °C, with a single crown in 30 minutes.
products.description: The ZDS-08 is Zahndent's new lift-type sintering furnace for fast and normal zirconia sintering. Six silicon-molybdenum heating rods take the chamber to 1650 °C, heating at 300 °C/min up to 1200 °C. A single crown veneer sinters in 30 minutes, and up to three teeth in 90 minutes. products.name: HALOT-X1 16K Resin 3D Printer
products.tagline: High-speed 16K resin printing up to 170 mm/h, with automatic resin feed and no levelling.
products.description: Creality presents the HALOT-X1 as a high-speed 16K resin 3D printer: "Scale Perfection, Simple Start." A 10.1-inch 16K mono LCD (15120 × 6230 px, 14 × 19 μm pixels) and a 92-zone honeycomb light source print at up to 170 mm/h in a 211.68 × 118.37 × 200 mm build volume. A top-down motion structure moves the vat and light source while the build plate stays still. The printer arrives pre-levelled, and the AFU system feeds, weighs and heats resin automatically, with RFID recognition for Creality resins. For a dental lab it suits models, trays and other 405 nm resin parts.
labValue: 16K resolution with 14 × 19 μm pixels for crisp margins and contacts on printed models.
Up to 170 mm/h, so full-arch models print in a short time.
Pre-levelled, with quick-release plates and automatic resin feed, so there is little set-up between jobs.
Prints any 405 nm resin; Creality resins load their parameters automatically by RFID.

features.title: 16K mono LCD
features.text: 10.1-inch screen, 15120 × 6230 px, 14 × 19 μm pixel size.

features.title: 92-zone intelligent exposure
features.text: The honeycomb matrix light source lights only the zones in use, which Creality says saves energy, improves accuracy and extends screen life.

features.title: Top-down motion
features.text: The resin vat and light source move while the build plate stays still, on dual linear rails and lead screws.

features.title: Leveling-free & quick release
features.text: Ships pre-levelled; the build plate pops out with a twist of its handles for scraper-free removal.

features.title: Smart AFU resin management
features.text: Automatic resin feed in and out, level and weight monitoring, RFID resin recognition and resin heating to 30–35 °C.

features.title: Stable chamber
features.text: Passive thermal circulation keeps the chamber temperature stable; a lid sensor stops the printer while the lid is open.

specs.label: Resin
specs.value: 405 nm UV resin (RFID recognition for Creality resins)

specs.label: Slicing software
specs.value: HALOT BOX / CHITUBOX (3 months of CHITUBOX Pro included)

workflow: Receives STL from CAD or the intraoral scanner
Prints models, trays and guides in 405 nm resin
Parts are washed and post-cured
